kangaroo-at-2011-02.prompt: A motorcycle driver covers a distance of 28 km in 30 minutes. What was his average speed in km/h?

kangaroo-at-2011-03.prompt: A square piece of paper is cut in a straight line into two pieces. Which of the following shapes can not be created?
kangaroo-at-2011-03.reviewNote: Two answers fit the question as printed: a square cannot be made, and neither can an equilateral triangle (a triangle cut from a square always has a 90° corner). The official key says (A); (E) is accepted too.

kangaroo-at-2011-05.prompt: Which of the following pieces do I need to complete the cuboid?
